Summary BlackRock Inflation Protected Bond Fund posted returns of 0.86% (Institutional shares) and 0.85% (Investor A shares, without sales charge) for the second quarter of 2026. Positive relative performance was supported by evolving inflation expectations during the quarter. The fund added to its U.S. real rates positioning, favoring five-year maturities.

BlackRock’s purpose is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. As a fiduciary to investors and a leading provider of financial technology, we help millions of people build savings that serve them throughout their lives by making investing easier and more affordable.
